contracts.name: scene_document
contracts.ordering: objects and tracks preserve producer order

contracts.name: semantic_scene_document
contracts.ordering: objects, tracks, signals, and bindings preserve producer order

contracts.name: canonical_scene_spec
contracts.ordering: objects are the canonical mixed geometry/text painter-order stream; tracks preserve producer order

contracts.name: patch_batch
contracts.ordering: patches are applied in array order

contracts.name: authoring_envelope
contracts.unknown_fields: ignored by the current client after envelope validation

contracts.name: authoring_result
contracts.notes: Shared Scene results carry a semantic execution descriptor. Explicit scene exports carry document, scene_spec and identities; callbacks execute only through the shared session.

numeric_contract.ids: Rust readers use u64; cross-language producers MUST stay in [0, 9007199254740991] so JavaScript represents IDs exactly
numeric_contract.floating_point: finite JSON numbers only; NaN and Infinity are not wire values
